Leo Belgicus.question: The third version was published in the later stages of the war, and after the independence of the Dutch Republic was confirmed in the Peace of Westphalia (_____)
Leo Belgicus.fact: The third version was published in the later stages of the war, and after the independence of the Dutch Republic was confirmed in the Peace of Westphalia (1648).

Leo Belgicus.question: It is called the _____, the Holland Lion, and shows only the province of Holland
Leo Belgicus.fact: It is called the Leo Hollandicus, the Holland Lion, and shows only the province of Holland.
